office.label: Civic & Business District
office.oneLineDistinction: Courts, government and professional offices in Downtown's core
office.shortDescription: The Civic & Business District concentrates City Hall, courts, legal services and professional offices in the Downtown core. Its civic anchors and conventional professional-office role distinguish it from the healthcare institutions west of Downtown.
worthKnowing: Downtown subdistricts differ sharply; confirm that an address sits in this office component.

office.label: Las Vegas Medical District
office.oneLineDistinction: Hospitals, medical offices and education west of Downtown
office.shortDescription: The Las Vegas Medical District is an institutional employment area west of Downtown centered on hospitals, medical offices and education. It belongs in Office exploration—not Industrial—because its defining commercial role is healthcare and professional space within an incorporated City district.
worthKnowing: Clinical infrastructure and permitted medical use must be verified by building.

retail.label: 18b Arts District
retail.oneLineDistinction: Galleries, vintage shops, restaurants and breweries south of Downtown
retail.shortDescription: The 18b Arts District concentrates galleries, vintage stores, restaurants, bars and small creative businesses in low-rise blocks south of the Downtown core. Its independent storefront and arts identity differs from Fremont East's entertainment corridor.
worthKnowing: Retail intensity varies between the district's core and its industrial-edged blocks.

retail.label: Fremont East
retail.oneLineDistinction: Restaurants, bars and entertainment east of Fremont Street Experience
retail.shortDescription: Fremont East is Downtown's concentrated restaurant, bar and entertainment corridor east of the Fremont Street Experience. Its nightlife-led storefront mix is distinct from the 18b Arts District's galleries, vintage retail and creative businesses.
worthKnowing: Customer patterns and operating hours vary by block and venue.

flex.label: Downtown Design District
flex.oneLineDistinction: Showrooms, workshops and creative businesses in industrial-era blocks
flex.shortDescription: The Downtown Design District combines showrooms, workshops and creative businesses in industrial-era low-rise buildings. Its office-production and display-space mix makes it a specialized Flex context, distinct from the 18b Arts District's customer-facing galleries, restaurants and shops.
worthKnowing: Verify loading, power, office ratio and permitted use for each property.

rejectedRelationships.label: Downtown Las Vegas
rejectedRelationships.reason: Civic & Business District is the distinct office component; a second generic Downtown card would be redundant.

rejectedRelationships.label: Las Vegas Medical District
rejectedRelationships.reason: Hospitals, medical offices and education do not establish an Industrial geography.
